t.eng-ummmuhammad: Ta, Seen, Meem
These are the verses of the clear Book

ayahs.arabic: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعࣱ نَّفۡسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: LaAAallaka bakhiAAun nafsaka alla yakoonoo mumineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers

ayahs.arabic: إِن نَّشَأۡ نُنَزِّلۡ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةࣰ فَظَلَّتۡ أَعۡنَٰقُهُمۡ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
ayahs.translit: In nasha nunazzil AAalayhim mina alssamai ayatan fathallat aAAnaquhum laha khadiAAeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن ذِكۡرࣲ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مُحۡدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wama yateehim min thikrin mina alrrahmani muhdathin illa kanoo AAanhu muAArideena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it

ayahs.arabic: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُواْ فَسَيَأۡتِيهِمۡ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُاْ مَا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
ayahs.translit: Faqad kaththaboo fasayateehim anbao ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَمۡ أَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجࣲ كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.translit: Awalam yaraw ila alardi kam anbatna feeha min kulli zawjin kareemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئۡتِ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Waith nada rabbuka moosa ani iti alqawma alththalimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people
The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
ayahs.translit: Qala rabbi innee akhafu an yukaththibooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me

ayahs.arabic: وَيَضِيقُ صَدۡرِي وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرۡسِلۡ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wayadeequ sadree wala yantaliqu lisanee faarsil ila haroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron

ayahs.arabic: وَلَهُمۡ عَلَيَّ ذَنۢبࣱ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقۡتُلُونِ
ayahs.translit: Walahum AAalayya thanbun faakhafu an yaqtulooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ كَلَّاۖ فَٱذۡهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسۡتَمِعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qala kalla faithhaba biayatina inna maAAakum mustamiAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening

ayahs.arabic: فَأۡتِيَا فِرۡعَوۡنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Fatiya firAAawna faqoola inna rasoolu rabbi alAAalameena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds
[Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَلَمۡ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدࣰ ا وَلَبِثۡتَ فِينَا مِنۡ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qala alam nurabbika feena waleedan walabithta feena min AAumurika sineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life

ayahs.arabic: وَفَعَلۡتَ فَعۡلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِي فَعَلۡتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.translit: WafaAAalta faAAlataka allatee faAAalta waanta mina alkafireena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَعَلۡتُهَآ إِذࣰ ا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.translit: Qala faAAaltuha ithan waana mina alddalleena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray

ayahs.arabic: فَفَرَرۡتُ مِنكُمۡ لَمَّا خِفۡتُكُمۡ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكۡمࣰ ا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Fafarartu minkum lamma khiftukum fawahaba lee rabbee hukman wajaAAalanee mina almursaleena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers

ayahs.arabic: وَتِلۡكَ نِعۡمَةࣱ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنۡ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.translit: Watilka niAAmatun tamunnuha AAalayya an AAabbadta banee israeela

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel
Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qala rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced
[Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear
[Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أُرۡسِلَ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمَجۡنُونࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Qala inna rasoolakumu allathee orsila ilaykum lamajnoonun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qala rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi wama baynahuma in kuntum taAAqiloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذۡتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيۡرِي لَأَجۡعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَسۡجُونِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qala laini ittakhathta ilahan ghayree laajAAalannaka mina almasjooneena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned
[Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَأۡتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qala fati bihi in kunta mina alssadiqeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful

ayahs.arabic: فَأَلۡقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعۡبَانࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Faalqa AAasahu faitha hiya thuAAbanun mubeenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest

ayahs.arabic: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيۡضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
ayahs.translit: WanazaAAa yadahu faitha hiya baydao lilnnathireena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لِلۡمَلَإِ حَوۡلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Qala lilmalai hawlahu inna hatha lasahirun AAaleemun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician

ayahs.arabic: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخۡرِجَكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِكُم بِسِحۡرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأۡمُرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Yureedu an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihi famatha tamuroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَرۡجِهۡ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبۡعَثۡ فِي ٱلۡمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo arjih waakhahu waibAAath fee almadaini hashireena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician
So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day
And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate

ayahs.arabic: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
ayahs.translit: LaAAallana nattabiAAu alssaharata in kanoo humu alghalibeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُواْ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجۡرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
ayahs.translit: Falamma jaa alssaharatu qaloo lifirAAawna ainna lana laajran in kunna nahnu alghalibeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ نَعَمۡ وَإِنَّكُمۡ إِذࣰ ا لَّمِنَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qala naAAam wainnakum ithan lamina almuqarrabeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلۡقُواْ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلۡقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qala lahum moosa alqoo ma antum mulqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw

ayahs.arabic: فَأَلۡقَوۡاْ حِبَالَهُمۡ وَعِصِيَّهُمۡ وَقَالُواْ بِعِزَّةِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Faalqaw hibalahum waAAisiyyahum waqaloo biAAizzati firAAawna inna lanahnu alghaliboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant

ayahs.arabic: فَأَلۡقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلۡقَفُ مَا يَأۡفِكُونَ
ayahs.translit: Faalqa moosa AAasahu faitha hiya talqafu ma yafikoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified
So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah]
They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds
The Lord of Moses and Aaron

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ قَبۡلَ أَنۡ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحۡرَ فَلَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفࣲ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu alssihra falasawfa taAAlamoona laoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum ajmaAAeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ لَا ضَيۡرَۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo la dayra inna ila rabbina munqaliboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا نَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Inna natmaAAu an yaghfira lana rabbuna khatayana an kunna awwala almumineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers

ayahs.arabic: ۞وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waawhayna ila moosa an asri biAAibadee innakum muttabaAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued
Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers
[And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band
And indeed, they are enraging us
And indeed, we are a cautious society
So We removed them from gardens and springs
And treasures and honorable station
Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel
So they pursued them at sunrise

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلۡجَمۡعَانِ قَالَ أَصۡحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدۡرَكُونَ
ayahs.translit: Falamma taraa aljamAAani qala ashabu moosa inna lamudrakoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ كَلَّآۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
ayahs.translit: Qala kalla inna maAAiya rabbee sayahdeeni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me

ayahs.arabic: فَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضۡرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرۡقࣲ كَٱلطَّوۡدِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ayahs.translit: Faawhayna ila moosa ani idrib biAAasaka albahra fainfalaqa fakana kullu firqin kaalttawdi alAAatheemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain
And We advanced thereto the pursuers
And We saved Moses and those with him, all together
Then We drowned the others

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
And recite to them the news of Abraham

ayahs.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma taAAbudoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ نَعۡبُدُ أَصۡنَامࣰ ا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo naAAbudu asnaman fanathallu laha AAakifeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted
He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate
Or do they benefit you, or do they harm

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ بَلۡ وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo bal wajadna abaana kathalika yafAAaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus
He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping
You and your ancient forefathers

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمۡ عَدُوࣱّ لِّيٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Fainnahum AAaduwwun lee illa rabba alAAalameena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds
Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me
And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink
And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لِي خَطِيٓـَٔتِي يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.translit: Waallathee atmaAAu an yaghfira lee khateeatee yawma alddeeni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense

ayahs.arabic: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي حُكۡمࣰ ا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.translit: Rabbi hab lee hukman waalhiqnee bialssaliheena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous

ayahs.arabic: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدۡقࣲ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
ayahs.translit: WaijAAal lee lisana sidqin fee alakhireena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations
And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure

ayahs.arabic: وَٱغۡفِرۡ لِأَبِيٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.translit: Waighfir liabee innahu kana mina alddalleena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray
And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالࣱ وَلَا بَنُونَ
ayahs.translit: Yawma la yanfaAAu malun wala banoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَنۡ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلۡبࣲ سَلِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Illa man ata Allaha biqalbin saleemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart
And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous
And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators

ayahs.arabic: وَقِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waqeela lahum ayna ma kuntum taAAbudoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship

ayahs.arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلۡ يَنصُرُونَكُمۡ أَوۡ يَنتَصِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Min dooni Allahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Other than Allah? Can they help you or help themselves
So they will be overturned into Hellfire, they and the deviators
And the soldiers of Iblees, all together
They will say while they dispute therein

ayahs.arabic: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.translit: TaAllahi in kunna lafee dalalin mubeenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error
When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds
And no one misguided us except the criminals
So now we have no intercessors
And not a devoted friend

ayahs.arabic: فَلَوۡ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةࣰ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Falaw anna lana karratan fanakoona mina almumineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
The people of Noah denied the messengers

ayahs.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ith qala lahum akhoohum noohun ala tattaqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allah
Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger
So fear Allah and obey me

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds
So fear Allah and obey me
They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ وَمَا عِلۡمِي بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qala wama AAilmee bima kanoo yaAAmaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do

ayahs.arabic: إِنۡ حِسَابُهُمۡ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّيۖ لَوۡ تَشۡعُرُونَ
ayahs.translit: In hisabuhum illa AAala rabbee law tashAAuroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive
And I am not one to drive away the believers
I am only a clear warner

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَرۡجُومِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo lain lam tantahi ya noohu latakoonanna mina almarjoomeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned
He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me

ayahs.arabic: فَٱفۡتَحۡ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ فَتۡحࣰ ا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَن مَّعِيَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Faiftah baynee wabaynahum fathan wanajjinee waman maAAiya mina almumineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
ayahs.translit: Faanjaynahu waman maAAahu fee alfulki almashhooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship
Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
Aad denied the messengers

ayahs.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ith qala lahum akhoohum hoodun ala tattaqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: When their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear Allah
Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger
So fear Allah and obey me

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds
Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves
And take for yourselves palaces and fortresses that you might abide eternally
And when you strike, you strike as tyrants
So fear Allah and obey me
And fear He who provided you with that which you know
Provided you with grazing livestock and children
And gardens and springs

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Innee akhafu AAalaykum AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوَعَظۡتَ أَمۡ لَمۡ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡوَٰعِظِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo sawaon AAalayna awaAAathta am lam takun mina alwaAAitheena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors
This is not but the custom of the former peoples
And we are not to be punished

ayahs.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Fakaththaboohu faahlaknahum inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
Thamud denied the messengers

ayahs.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ith qala lahum akhoohum salihun ala tattaqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: When their brother Salih said to them, "Will you not fear Allah
Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger
So fear Allah and obey me

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds
Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death]
Within gardens and springs
And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit

ayahs.arabic: وَتَنۡحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتࣰ ا فَٰرِهِينَ

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill
So fear Allah and obey me
And do not obey the order of the transgressors

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُونَ
ayahs.translit: Allatheena yufsidoona fee alardi wala yuslihoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend
They said, "You are only of those affected by magic

ayahs.arabic: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثۡلُنَا فَأۡتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.translit: Ma anta illa basharun mithluna fati biayatin in kunta mina alssadiqeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةࣱ لَّهَا شِرۡبࣱ وَلَكُمۡ شِرۡبُ يَوۡمࣲ مَّعۡلُومࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Qala hathihi naqatun laha shirbun walakum shirbu yawmin maAAloomin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءࣲ فَيَأۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Wala tamassooha bisooin fayakhuthakum AAathabu yawmin AAatheemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day
But they hamstrung her and so became regretful

ayahs.arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Faakhathahumu alAAathabu inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
The people of Lot denied the messengers

ayahs.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ith qala lahum akhoohum lootun ala tattaqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allah
Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger
So fear Allah and obey me

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds
Do you approach males among the worlds

ayahs.arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمۡ رَبُّكُم مِّنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ عَادُونَ
ayahs.translit: Watatharoona ma khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwajikum bal antum qawmun AAadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُخۡرَجِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo lain lam tantahi ya lootu latakoonanna mina almukhrajeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted
He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it]
My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do
So We saved him and his family, all
Except an old woman among those who remained behind
Then We destroyed the others

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم مَّطَرࣰ اۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
ayahs.translit: Waamtarna AAalayhim mataran fasaa mataru almunthareena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
The companions of the thicket denied the messengers

ayahs.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ith qala lahum shuAAaybun ala tattaqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah
Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger
So fear Allah and obey me

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds

ayahs.translit: Awfoo alkayla wala takoonoo mina almukhsireena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss
And weigh with an even balance

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تَبۡخَسُواْ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wala tabkhasoo alnnasa ashyaahum wala taAAthaw fee alardi mufsideena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption
And fear He who created you and the former creation
They said, "You are only of those affected by magic

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثۡلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wama anta illa basharun mithluna wain nathunnuka lamina alkathibeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars

ayahs.arabic: فَأَسۡقِطۡ عَلَيۡنَا كِسَفࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.translit: Faasqit AAalayna kisafan mina alssamai in kunta mina alssadiqeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful
He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do

ayahs.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.translit: Fakaththaboohu faakhathahum AAathabu yawmi alththullati innahu kana AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers
And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds
The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down
Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners
In a clear Arabic language
And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُمۡ ءَايَةً أَن يَعۡلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُاْ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.translit: Awalam yakun lahum ayatan an yaAAlamahu AAulamao banee israeela

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel
And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners

ayahs.arabic: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Faqaraahu AAalayhim ma kanoo bihi mumineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it
Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals

ayahs.arabic: لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ
ayahs.translit: La yuminoona bihi hatta yarawoo alAAathaba alaleema

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment
And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not
And they will say, "May we be reprieved
So for Our punishment are they impatient
Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
And then there came to them that which they were promised

ayahs.arabic: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُمَتَّعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ma aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yumattaAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wama ahlakna min qaryatin illa laha munthiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
As a reminder; and never have We been unjust
And the devils have not brought the revelation down
It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able
Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُعَذَّبِينَ
ayahs.translit: Fala tadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fatakoona mina almuAAaththabeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished
And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred

ayahs.arabic: وَٱخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Waikhfid janahaka limani ittabaAAaka mina almumineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنۡ عَصَوۡكَ فَقُلۡ إِنِّي بَرِيٓءࣱ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Fain AAasawka faqul innee bareeon mimma taAAmaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing
And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
Who sees you when you arise
And your movement among those who prostrate
Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing

ayahs.arabic: هَلۡ أُنَبِّئُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
ayahs.translit: Hal onabbiokum AAala man tanazzalu alshshayateenu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend
They descend upon every sinful liar
They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars
And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّهُمۡ فِي كُلِّ وَادࣲ يَهِيمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Alam tara annahum fee kulli wadin yaheemoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
And that they say what they do not do

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرࣰ ا وَٱنتَصَرُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْۗ وَسَيَعۡلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَيَّ مُنقَلَبࣲ يَنقَلِبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati wathakaroo Allaha katheeran waintasaroo min baAAdi ma thulimoo wasayaAAlamu allatheena thalamoo ayya munqalabin yanqaliboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned
